# hivemind_forager_integration_teams (Data Source)

Team slugs accepted in `allowed_teams` of organization service integrations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivemind_forager_integration_teams" "available" {}

output "integration_teams" {
  value = data.hivemind_forager_integration_teams.available.teams
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `teams` (List of String) Available team slugs in `owner/team` format.
